# Data Time Machine

An open-source pipeline investigation lab by Diego Crisafulli.

The app demonstrates deterministic replay, immutable snapshots, event-level lineage, schema migration, deduplication and event-time lateness handling. All example transaction data is synthetic. Processing runs locally in a Web Worker; there is no production data connection or backend database.

Source and documentation: https://github.com/diegocrisafu/me-lazy
Live demo: https://diegocrisafu.github.io/me-lazy/
